title: Mayer-Vietoris distinguished triangle for derived global sections in the unbounded derived category
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a ringed space X which is the union of two open subsets U and V, the lemma gives a distinguished triangle relating the derived global sections of an arbitrary object of the unbounded derived category to those over U, V and the intersection, together with the resulting long exact cohomology sequence and functoriality in the object (statement lines 8199-8218). The proof uses a K-injective representative whose terms are injectives, so that the four derived global section functors are computed by the corresponding complexes of sections, and then identifies the triangle as the one attached to a short exact sequence of complexes of abelian groups (proof lines 8221-8241). Exactness of that sequence is the termwise statement already established in the proof of the Mayer-Vietoris lemma, and functoriality follows from the functoriality of the K-injective construction (proof lines 8242-8246). The claim is H2: the same shape as the absolute and relative Mayer-Vietoris triangles, with the exactness input cited rather than rechecked and the unbounded setting handled by the K-injective representative.
